title: Affine computation of derived pullback and derived tensor product
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback $Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] and derived categories as in [def-pc-derived-category]; for a scheme $Z$ write $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_Z}L$ for the derived tensor product, the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] of a K-flat resolution of $K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] with $L$. (1) For opens $U\subseteq X$, $V\subseteq Y$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$ and $E$ in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ there is a canonical isomorphism $(Lf^*E)|_U\cong L(f|_U)^*(E|_V)$ in $D(\mathcal O_U)$, and for $K,L$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ a canonical isomorphism $(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)|_U\cong K|_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}L|_U$. (2) If $X=\operatorname{Spec}(B)$, $Y=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and $f$ is given by a ring map $A\to B$, then for every complex $M^\bullet$ of $A$-modules $Lf^*\widetilde{M^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B}$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$, where $\widetilde{(-)}$ is the termwise associated sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] and $\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}$ the derived tensor product of complexes of modules. (3) If $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, then for complexes $M^\bullet,N^\bullet$ of $A$-modules $\widetilde{M^\bullet}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde{N^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N^\bullet}$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$.

source.place: Lemma 36.3.8 (Tag 08DW) part (2) and its proof ('Lf^* is compatible with restricting to open subschemes'), Lemma 36.3.9 (Tag 08DX) part (2); both via Lemma 36.3.6 (perfect-lemma-affine-K-flat)

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution P^\bullet\to E on Y. Restrict it to V; this is pullback along the open immersion V\hookrightarrow Y, so [lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation] makes P^\bullet|_V K-flat. Pulling this resolution back along f|_U:U\to V and applying [def-pc-derived-pullback] gives (Lf^*E)|_U\cong L(f|_U)^*(E|_V). For K,L on X, choose a K-flat resolution Q^\bullet\to K. Restriction along U\hookrightarrow X preserves K-flatness by the same cited lemma, and restriction commutes termwise with the sheaf tensor product and its direct-sum totalization [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]; hence the defining K-flat computation gives (K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)|_U\cong K|_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}L|_U.

source.place: Lemma 36.3.8 (Tag 08DW), proof of compatibility with restriction; Lemma 36.3.9 (Tag 08DX), restriction of the tensor complex

proof.text: In the affine case X = Spec(B), Y = Spec(A), choose a K-flat resolution P^\bullet\to M^\bullet of complexes of A-modules ([lem-pc-kflat-resolution] on the one-point space with ring A). By [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] the termwise associated sheaf is a functor on D(A), so \widetilde{P^\bullet}\to\widetilde{M^\bullet} is a quasi-isomorphism, and \widetilde{P^\bullet} is K-flat over \mathcal O_Y by [lem-pc-affine-tilde-kflat]; thus it is a K-flat resolution of \widetilde{M^\bullet}. By [def-pc-derived-pullback], Lf^*\widetilde{M^\bullet}\cong f^*\widetilde{P^\bullet}, the termwise module pullback. By [lem-weil-pbc-tilde-pullback-base-change], applied in each degree and natural in the module (so compatible with the differentials), f^*\widetilde{P^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{P^\bullet\otimes_A B}. The module complex P^\bullet\otimes_A B represents M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B because P^\bullet is K-flat, and the associated-sheaf functor on D(A) [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] yields the canonical isomorphism Lf^*\widetilde{M^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B}.

For X = Spec(A), resolve M^\bullet by a K-flat complex P^\bullet of A-modules [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. As in step 2, \widetilde{P^\bullet}\to\widetilde{M^\bullet} is a quasi-isomorphism [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] and \widetilde{P^\bullet} is K-flat [lem-pc-affine-tilde-kflat], so by the definition of the derived tensor product through a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex], \widetilde{M^\bullet}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde{N^\bullet} is the total tensor complex \widetilde{P^\bullet}\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde{N^\bullet} [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-tensor] in each bidegree, natural in both modules, \widetilde{P^p}\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde{N^q}\cong\widetilde{P^p\otimes_A N^q}; tilde commutes with finite direct sums (it is additive), so the total complexes agree: \widetilde{P^\bullet}\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde{N^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{P^\bullet\otimes_A N^\bullet}. Since P^\bullet is K-flat, P^\bullet\otimes_A N^\bullet represents M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N^\bullet, giving \widetilde{M^\bullet}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde{N^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N^\bullet}.
